constraints.name: cp04_finding_resolution
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((result = 'attention'::text) AND (resolution = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'resolved'::text])) AND (note IS NOT NULL) AND (char_length(btrim(note)) >= 3)) OR ((result = ANY (ARRAY['ok'::text, 'not_checked'::text])) AND (resolution = 'not_applicable'::text))))
